conclusion.proven: Both boots recorded an early diagnostic transport FlushFailed, after at least one successful diagnostic flush, and later reached TransportRecoveryCompleted. This immutable historical record is not a failed product Heartbeat/106-ms transaction and is not evidence of a current E220/RF failure.
conclusion.detail_semantics: MCU monotonic now_ms low32 at the first transport failure; not byte deficit, error count, source line, or elapsed flush duration.
conclusion.not_first_transmission_failure: first_failure.stage_mask 0x00007fff includes FlushCompleted and excludes prior TransportRecoveryEntered; therefore at least one diagnostic flush succeeded before the recorded first failure.
conclusion.retry_semantics: A same-epoch completed diagnostic is held and only its flush retried. The immutable 68-byte record persists even after recovery; its detail does not mean a present permanent stop.

source_bindings.meaning: r19_latch_runtime_stage_transport_failure stores domain OR reason and low32(now_ms).
latch_first_failure returns without replacement once first_failure is nonzero.
FlushCompleted is bit14; TransportRecoveryEntered is bit15.
diagnostic per-flush budget100ms, complete-frame deadline500ms, flush-only recovery120000ms.
Ground calls wrapper flush_ground_usb_transport; Vehicle directly calls flushTxComplete.
stable epoch with time remaining returns for another bounded flush; otherwise FlushFailed is latched. Non-bootstrap epoch change can also reach FlushFailed before deadline.
reason FlushFailed; stable epoch and completed publisher may arm FrameFlush recovery.
same-epoch completed publisher recovery retries only flush, never replaying accepted payload.
successful recovery clears active transport_failed and records TransportRecoveryCompleted, not immutable first failure.
diagnostic isCDC_Connected trusts cached payload pickup, not explicit application reader arm.
flush may fail for unavailable buffers/lock or for timeout/host/epoch/software/FIFO/pickup conditions; first diagnostic failure lacks this snapshot.

ground.first_failure_frame_candidate: ALIVE ordinal1 is consistent with prior successful ARMED ordinal0 and first captured ordinal2 prepared later than the failure. Exact failed ordinal/action was not latched; keep as candidate, not direct observation.

vehicle.first_failure_frame_candidate: After an earlier successful diagnostic flush, before captured ordinal5; exact failed frame ordinal/action not recorded.

raw_replay.method: Selected pure function definitions only from the existing diagnostic parser, loaded through PowerShell AST. Pinned80 message definitions from core/src/mavlink_frame.cpp. Every saved native read chunk replayed in order; R19A payload format, CRC, ordinal, and full-frame SHA compared.
raw_replay.scope: Saved post-open raw stream only; absence of duplicate payload does not measure how many flush-only calls occurred or what happened before raw coverage.

hypotheses.name: Mission Planner protocol/RF corruption caused this diagnostic failure
hypotheses.reason: The failing path is local MCU diagnostic USB flushing. Saved current Ground stream has40 CRC-valid product Heartbeats and no product-first-failure latch.

hypotheses.name: Application reader not yet ready / host pickup paused
hypotheses.reason: Diagnostic admission accepts cached USB connectivity or complete bootstrap capacity without explicit reader ARM. However there are no guaranteed PC/MCU clock bounds for first failure and no preserved first diagnostic FIFO snapshot.

hypotheses.name: Internal USB ring/FIFO/pickup completion logic stall
hypotheses.reason: Flush false is proven but first-failure wait reason, queues, lock ownership, expected/observed epochs, payload generations and call timestamps were not latched for that diagnostic transaction.

hypotheses.name: Epoch change rather than500ms diagnostic deadline
hypotheses.reason: The same reason code can be reached by a non-bootstrap changed epoch. Final epoch1/bus-reset0 is a later snapshot and cannot replace first-failure evidence.

required_next_evidence: Immutable first diagnostic failure record: action, ordinal, frame hash/size, accepted offset, start/deadline/end MCU64 timestamps.
Same-boundary expected/observed epoch, HWCDC terminal/blocker snapshot, ring/stash/FIFO/publish/pickup state and actual per-call return.
Keep first-ever diagnostic failure separate from latest successful recovery and post-reader-close backpressure.
Use matched nonce and guaranteed clock uncertainty bounds before claiming first failure preceded PC reader start.
limitations: Ground failure preceding its ClockRequest is established in one MCU clock only; no cross-clock ordering against PC COM open/read is claimed.
0x7fff does not identify the failed frame; Ground ordinal1 is a bounded candidate under ordinary diagnostic cadence/source assumptions, not a directly saved identity.
Final FIFO counters cover boot through JTAG, including after capture closed. 110/194 timeouts are not first-startup-only counts.
No500ms exceedance, missing byte count, physical FIFO location or causal host-readiness defect can be inferred from detail10029/2586 alone.
Recovery and successful captured traffic do not erase historical failures or authorize product acceptance/deployment.
No source changes, measurement tool changes, COM/PnP/process/JTAG operations or new hardware test were performed.
